product.name: Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor Coupling Offset
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, the Fernco Rubber Flexible Drainage Adaptor Coupling Offset is designed to meet and surpass the strict demands of the drainage industry, offering a solution for various adaptation needs. This ensures it is cost-effective, eliminating potential bush requirements. The clamping band fastens against two or more external ribs on the plastic ribbed pipe to ensure a high-performance seal regardless of the coupling movement or position.

product.name: Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plant from Graf will treat the water, so that it is clean enough to be discharged into a water course (depending on how frequently it is being used and the manufacturer’s guidelines). However, One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plants do require a power source and requires emptying approximately every year.
The water discharged from the One2Clean Plus packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.
Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant Process

Untreated waste enters the One2Clean tank via the inlet on the side.
Wastewater then falls directly into the biological zone where the treatment takes place, allowing micro-organisms to start the breakdown process.
Compressed air is used initially for aeration through the diffuser, intermittent to achieve the best treatment performance.
Aeration is then stopped allowing the activated waste to sink to the bottom.
Compressed air is sent through the One2Clean tank once again, extracting the cleaned water near the surface.
This water passes through a sampling point before leaving the plant, where samples can be taken to confirm the quality of effluent.
The above process occurs twice per day, each lasting 12 hours.
The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer’s instructions
Numerous companiescan dispose of the waste, these must be a registered waste carrier

Features & Benefits

One tank with just one chamber
Less energy consumption
No mechanical elements in the wastewater
No pumps in the wastewater
No electrical components in the wastewater
Incredibly low volume of sewage sludge
Odourless, clear treated water for extraction
State-of-the-art manufacturing for maximum stability
100% watertight and corrosion-resistant
Can be installed in groundwater
Simple maintenance via an integrated, self-cleaning sampling container
More advanced control panel than the standard One2Clean
Control panel allows additional plug in retro fitting of add on systems
product.variant_name: Graf One2Clean Xtra Sewage Treatment Plant 5 Person with Pedestrian Lid

product.name: Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plant from Graf will treat the water, so that it is clean enough to be discharged into a water course (depending on how frequently it is being used and the manufacturer’s guidelines). However, One2Clean Plus sewage treatment plants do require a power source and requires emptying approximately every year.
The water discharged from the One2Clean Plus packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.
Graf One2Clean Plus Sewage Treatment Plant Process

Untreated waste enters the One2Clean tank via the inlet on the side.
Wastewater then falls directly into the biological zone where the treatment takes place, allowing micro-organisms to start the breakdown process.
Compressed air is used initially for aeration through the diffuser, intermittent to achieve the best treatment performance.
Aeration is then stopped allowing the activated waste to sink to the bottom.
Compressed air is sent through the One2Clean tank once again, extracting the cleaned water near the surface.
This water passes through a sampling point before leaving the plant, where samples can be taken to confirm the quality of effluent.
The above process occurs twice per day, each lasting 12 hours.
The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer’s instructions
Numerous companiescan dispose of the waste, these must be a registered waste carrier

product.name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: Designed for outdoor cleaning and irrigation purposes, the Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvesting system by Graf is ideal for collecting rainwater from the roof of your property and then feeding it into the underground tank via the downpipes. Available in various sizes, you can use the harvester for domestic or commercial use with the choice of either an A15 lid for pedestrian use or a B125 cast iron lid for light vehicular use.Before entering the underground tank, the water passes through a filter to remove debris, ensuring clear water for use. An underground pressure-sensitive pump is also installed. When a valve or tap is opened, the water is pumped under pressure until the valve is closed allowing the system to re-pressurise and turn off the power to the pump.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester PackageLightweight for easy handling and transportationEasy and safe to assembleA15 and B125 lid options and choice of harvester sizes availableEPDM used to profile sealings and ensure minimum life of 25 yearsConstant monitoring of production ensures consistent qualitySuitable for vehicle loading when a telescopic cast iron cover is usedTwo additional hose-lock connection extraction pointsFilter prevents leaves, moss and debris from travelling with the rainwater out of the tankFilter package 2 consists of an internal Universal Filter 3, an inflow stilling system for controlling the water inflow as well as a Spannfix connection sleeve, Rodent Guard and an Overflow siphon. The Integra Inox Submersible pump features an automatic start/stop function with a floating water extraction unit and protection against dry running.Please note: If you have an above-ground tank, you can use a pump to extract the rainwater. However, if the tank is underground, you'll need a pump to extract the rainwater. It's important to consider what you'll be using the harvested rainwater for, as this will determine whether you need a backup function for periods where little rainwater is collected.

product.name: Graf Carat Direct Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: The Graf Carat Direct Rainwater Harvester Package is available in various sizes for efficient rainwater harvesting. Whether for residential or commercial use, this system is designed to collect rainwater from building roofs, providing a cost-effective and eco-friendly water source for applications such as WCs, washing machines, irrigation, and outdoor cleaning.Choose between an A15 lid suitable for pedestrian areas or a B125 cast iron lid designed for light vehicular use, tailoring the system to your specific needs. The Graf Carat Direct system incorporates an innovative filtration process that varies based on the roof's surface area, preventing leaves, moss, and debris from entering the storage tank and ensuring the purity of the collected rainwater.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Direct Rainwater Harvester PackageOffers efficient, cost-effective and eco-friendly rainwater harvesting in various sizesFor residential and commercial applicationsChoose between A15 or B125 lids to suit pedestrian or light vehicular areasInnovative filtration prevents debris from entering the tankProvides water for applications such as WCs, washing machines, irrigation, and outdoor cleaningReliability is enhanced with a mains water backup function, ensuring uninterrupted serviceLightweight, easy to transport and safe assemblyEPDM to profile sealings lasts more than 25 yearsOnce securely stored in the tank, rainwater is easily extracted. Above-ground tanks feature a simple tap for convenient access, like a standard water butt, while underground tanks utilise pumps tailored to different applications. To enhance reliability, the Graf Carat Direct system can be equipped with a mains water backup function, ensuring uninterrupted service during periods of limited rainwater collection. Supplied with a mains water top-up unit measure the level of water in the underground tank.

product.name: Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plant can be flexibly adjusted to changing conditions by altering the cycle times. The air pressure holes are colour coded to avoid installation errors; the whole system just needs to be fitted to the baffle of the reservoir.
Graf Klaro E Professional Sewage Treatment Plant Features & Benefits

No live technology in the reservoir
Air compressor is very durable and whisper-quiet
Flexible, as expandable
Can be switched to holiday mode
Easy to install
Low maintenance
10-year warranty on sewage reservoirs
2-year warranty on technology
product.variant_name: Graf One Advanced Sewage Treatment Plant 10 Person with Pedestrian Lid

product.description: Formerly Flexseal, the Fernco flexible drain couplings serve a specific purpose in drain construction, particularly in scenarios where the resistance to earth loads, typically provided by standard couplings, is not required. product.description: Formerly Flexseal, the Fernco EPDM Straight Plumbing Couplings are used to connect, repair and maintain drainage systems and small-diameter non-pressure pipelines. product.name: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain Pipes
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, Fernco Puddle Flanges serve the purpose of sealing the area around pipes that pass through concrete structures like tanks, manhole chambers, shafts, floor slabs and basements. Manufactured from sturdy EPDM, these reliable flanges are typically installed during the construction phase.When pipes pass through concrete, they do not bond to the concrete, creating a potential route for water to flow along the external surface of the pipe. However, Fernco Puddle Flanges act as a barrier, preventing water penetration in such situations. The flange is clamped onto the pipe, obstructing this direct water route. During the pouring process, the seal body is compressed, and if the concrete shrinks during curing, the rubber in the flange relaxes and maintains a seal, preventing any water flow along this path.Features & Benefits: Fernco Puddle Flange for Drain PipesHighly versatile, cost-effective solution for sealing pipes which pass through concreteSuitable for use in walls, floors and ceilingsGood chemical resistanceQuick & easy to installAvailable in a wide range of sizes

product.name: Freeflow Deepflow Plastic Gutter
product.description:
The Freeflow deep gutter system includes a deep round style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation.
The deep gutter has a high flow capacity which is ideal for areas prone to high precipitation. An additional advantage of the deep gutter is less regular cleaning and maintenance due to the shape of the profile.
The gutter is 116mm wide, 77mm deep and 4m long.
Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the deep gutter system.

product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Square Style Plastic Gutter Angle
product.description:
The Freeflow square line gutter system includes a traditional square style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. The gutter is 114mm wide, 57mm deep and is available in lengths of 4m and 5m. All square line gutter system parts are available in white, black and brown. The square line gutter is compatible with other square line rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the square line gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Coupling
product.description: Crafted from stainless steel for durability, this Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe Coupling is easy to install alongside cast iron pipework. It seamlessly incorporates into the dry-jointed pipework system, which is designed to resist accidental external damage and vandalism across several applications. Constructing your system becomes effortless with the twin screw coupling, ensuring secure connections.Alongside the ductile and stainless steel couplings, this comprehensive soil and waste pipework system is formed with socketless fixing between pipe and fittings without the burden of special installation equipment. Ideal for rainwater installations when paired with Harmer Roof Outlets, the system features 3m long pipes and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe CouplingAllows for secure connectionsFor use with the cast iron pipeworkStainless steel structure for durabilityEasy to install with lightweight structureResilient epoxy coatings permit low maintenanceSystem is versatile across applicationsNo need for special installation equipment Pipes and fittings are meticulously crafted from grey iron, adhering to DIN 1691 standards (exceeding BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while couplings include stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. Primer coatings (minimum thickness of 40 µm) adorn pipe exteriors, complemented by an epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm) on their interiors. In contrast, fittings are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy layer (minimum thickness of 60 µm) for less maintenance throughout their service life.Harmer SML is at the leading edge of cast iron technology, boasting BBA and Kitemark certification, full compliance with BS EN 877 standards, and CE Mark conformity. product.name: Fernco EPDM Moulded Bush Drain Pipe Adaptor Coupling
product.description: Formerly Flexseal, these Fernco Moulded Bushes are durable EPDM rubber rings designed as supplementary components for Shear Banded Couplings or Lateral Connection Saddles. Their purpose is to help connect pipes with different outside diameters. These robust rubber rings serve to increase the outside diameter of a pipe, ensuring a proper fit when the pipe is too small for the coupling or saddle being used. This convenient solution facilitates a reliable and high-performance seal.Once fitted, the bush effectively fills the gap between the outside of the pipe and the inside of the coupling, creating a secure and dependable connection. product.name: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set
product.description: Effortlessly control penstock valves with Fernco's Telescopic HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle Set. Ideal for below-ground or pit installations, these sets offer remote operation. Choose from a range of sizes to match your specific needs for seamless water flow management.To install your extension spindle, start by removing the BS cap. Then, place the extension spindle over the penstock spindle. Position the upper bracket 150mm below the deck or the top of the spindle extension. Divide the remaining brackets evenly over the length of the spindle extension, using one additional bracket for every 3m. Mark the mounting holes for the brackets to ensure the extension spindle is in the correct position. Remove the spindle extension and install the brackets as required. Finally, reinstall the spindle extension and adjust the bracket positions as needed to ensure proper alignment.Features & Benefits: Fernco HDPE Penstock Valve Extension Spindle SetAllows remote valve control of your penstockDesigned for below-ground or pit installationsVarious sizes available to suit specific requirementsSimplifies water flow managementQuick and easy installation

product.name: Freeflow Square Style Plastic Gutter External Stopened
product.description:
The Freeflow square line gutter system includes a traditional square style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. The gutter is 114mm wide, 57mm deep and is available in lengths of 4m and 5m. All square line gutter system parts are available in white, black and brown. The square line gutter is compatible with other square line rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the square line gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Plastic Ogee Gutter Internal Stopend
product.description:
The Freeflow ogee gutter system includes a traditional ‘s’ curved style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. An additional benefit for customers is the symmetrical shape of the ogee gutter which eliminates the need to stock a range of left and right hand parts. The gutter is 135mm wide, 77mm deep and is 4m long. All ogee gutter system parts are available in white, black, brown and caramel. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the ogee gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: ACO Threshold A15 Plastic Channel Drain - 1000mm
product.description:
ACO Threshold channel drain is designed for use in domestic properties to eliminate any water from pooling at external doors. The threshold is only 60mm wide and sits flush to the door for maximum discretion, allowing water to be drained away quickly and efficiently. Whilst ACO Threshold channel drain has been built with long-life and durability in mind, a choice of built-in silver or black Heelguard grates offer aesthetic design too.
This ACO Threshold channel drain comes with an attached black aluminium grate with Heelguard design. Heelguard design means that high heels can't become lodged in the grate as the slits are too narrow, reducing the risk of injury to people entering and exiting the property or damage to the channel drain grate. The extruded plastic base of ACO Threshold channel drain only bolsters the security of the drain once the system has been bedded in concrete.
ACO Threshold channel drain can be connected, thanks to 80mm diameter outlets, to domestic soakaways and accessories like a drain connector, 80mm bottom outlet and closing end cap complete the drain system.

product.name: ACO C-Line Shower & Wet Room Channel Drain Grating
product.description:
The ShowerDrain C series is characterised by modern design and perfect functionality. The basic is the high quality stainless steel which is used for the production of the shower channel itself, gully and grating. The foul air trap is made out of polypropylene. The steel parts are passivated; the gratings are brushed to the silk gloss. From the user's point of view the ACO ShowerDrain C excelled especially by the high flow rate, very low construction height and very easy maintenance.

50mm Outlet
High Flow Rate 0.9l/s
Channel Supplied with Grating

Low Construction Height
The standard model of ACO ShowerDrain C 50 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has a construction height only 92 mm. The lowered model (30 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has incredible construction height of only 65 mm. If integrated foul air trap not needed, it is possible to install ACO ShowerDrain C only with the spigot. In this case, the construction height is equal to the height of the channel only 18 mm. These values enable very wide application of ACO ShowerDrain C in the modern new buildings and buildings under reconstruction.Easy maintenance
The user´s comfort is increased by the efficiency of the foul air trap and its easy cleaning. Syphon (foul air trap) is made out of plastics. The reliable seal is injection-moulded together with the foul air trap. Due to this construction, there is no risk of losing of the sealing, or another malfunction. The foul air trap can be easily removed from the shower channel. It is easy to disassemble it into two separate parts and clean it by hand or in a dish washer.

product.name: ACO C-Line Shower & Wet Room Channel Drain Grating
product.description:
The ShowerDrain C series is characterised by modern design and perfect functionality. The basic is the high quality stainless steel which is used for the production of the shower channel itself, gully and grating. The foul air trap is made out of polypropylene. The steel parts are passivated; the gratings are brushed to the silk gloss. From the user's point of view the ACO ShowerDrain C excelled especially by the high flow rate, very low construction height and very easy maintenance.

50mm Outlet
High Flow Rate 0.9l/s
Channel Supplied with Grating

Low Construction Height
The standard model of ACO ShowerDrain C 50 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has a construction height only 92 mm. The lowered model (30 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has incredible construction height of only 65 mm. If integrated foul air trap not needed, it is possible to install ACO ShowerDrain C only with the spigot. In this case, the construction height is equal to the height of the channel only 18 mm. These values enable very wide application of ACO ShowerDrain C in the modern new buildings and buildings under reconstruction.Easy maintenance
The user´s comfort is increased by the efficiency of the foul air trap and its easy cleaning. Syphon (foul air trap) is made out of plastics. The reliable seal is injection-moulded together with the foul air trap. Due to this construction, there is no risk of losing of the sealing, or another malfunction. The foul air trap can be easily removed from the shower channel. It is easy to disassemble it into two separate parts and clean it by hand or in a dish washer.

product.name: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Adjustable Shallow Channel
product.description: The FreeDeck is an advanced roof and balcony drainage system from ACO. Combining line drainage with point drainage using an open-sided drainage channel, this system collects and conveys rainwater to drainage points within raised or suspended deck structures. Rainwater interception happens at three points, including surface run-off, percolation within the deck and rainwater outlet positions. To ensure you can rely on the product's quality, the channel complies with national access regulations. Manufactured from galvanised steel, this adjustable shallow channel is installed directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. Where pavings are required to be laid 'open or closed joint', an efficient drainage solution is created. product.description:
ACO’s HygieneFirst drainage systems fulfils the stringent hygienic requirements to minimise harmful bacteria and pathogen contamination of food arising from the drainage elements.
This is done by applying relevant hygiene design principles reserved for food contact surfaces by the implementation of BS EN 1672, BS EN ISO 14159 and EHEDG Document 8 requirements to drainage element design.
ACO’s slip-resistant grates have no mesh and are fully cast or welded, and every joint is curved to make removal and cleaning an easy and safe process (without the need for inappropriate power washing). 
Features and Benefits

Manufactured from 304 grade stainless steel
Tested and certified according to BS EN 1253-1
Design enables quick and easy cleaning
Rounded corners
Hygienic design following BS EN 1672, BS EN ISO 14159 and EHEDG document No. 8, 13 and 44

product.description: Constructed from robust 304-grade Stainless Steel with a 1.5mm material thickness, this Kitchen Tray Standard Edge Channel with a 142mm Outlet is a key component of ACO's HygieneFirst drainage system. Engineered to meet rigorous hygienic standards, it serves as a proactive measure to minimise the risk of harmful bacteria and pathogen contamination in food, aligning with BS EN 1672, BS EN ISO 14159 and EHEDG Document 8 requirements for drainage element design.Designed for versatility, this standard edge channel drain is suitable for tiled, concrete or resin floors, providing adaptability for diverse settings. Its features include a waterproof membrane for seamless connection to the ACO Gully 157 body, a fully drainable sump, a reinforced channel base for stability in tray channels exceeding 300mm and a contoured outlet ensuring positive drainage even at low flow rates. As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.

product.name: ACO 304 Grade Stainless Steel Double Socketed Pipe EPDM Seal
product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.
ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.
ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.
ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.

Easy installation

As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

product.description:
Our gullies represent the cumulation of many years' practical experience and design know-how in stainless steel fabrication technologies. Made by state of the art European plants that produce products of consistent outstanding quality but with economic benefits that can only be realised through the most advanced manufacturing methods. All the systems featured here are manufactured in austenitic stainless steel grades 304 or 316 and are fully pickle passivated in order to ensure corrosion free joints.The gully systems fall into five main categories: Fixed Height and Telescopic gully systems, EG150 Eurogully range, Rodding Eyes, Micro Floor Gullies and Bespoke gullies. Each has particular benefits which are summarised briefly here with in depth description and full feature and benefit listings in their relevant sections of the catalogue.

Hygienic design including large radii formed contours, deep-drawn components and minimal welds to minimise crevices and bacteria traps according to BS EN 1672 and BS EN ISO 14159
Stainless steel gullies fully compliant to BS EN 1253
Available in 304 and 316 grades of stainless steel
Fully removable and easily cleaned stainless steel foul air trap (FAT)
Removable hygienic and corrosion resistant Nitrile FAT support
Capacity with high flow rates
Wide range of gratings to Load Class  L15 - M125 (BS EN 1253) or C250 (BS EN 124)
Includes Foul Air Trap

 
Top Size Gully Requirements 
200mm x 200mm requires 168mm x 168mm x 25mm gully grate
250mm x 250mm requires 218mm x 218mm x 30mm gully grate
